desc: Read-only m1n1-side NVMe probe: does m1n1's own pre-Linux ANS+SART/RTKit path work on T6040? Unblocks the upstream chainload= stage-2 architecture after the enrolled appended-payload route was root-caused as unusable. Runs scripts/t6040-nvme-probe.py against the ALREADY-ENROLLED live-proven bare loader 1394c345 (no rebuild, no enrollment/boot-policy/APFS change). Safety: the proxy has NO P_NVME_WRITE opcode at all — script calls only nvme_init/nvme_read/nvme_shutdown, never nvme_flush, so it cannot modify the SSD; fail-closed gate on J614s/chip 0x6040 + /arm-io/ans + /arm-io/sart-ans; bounded 1-8 4KiB reads from nsid 1, hex-dump only, no mount/parse; nvme_shutdown in finally. Residual risk is a hang/SError wedging m1n1 -> recovery boot; no data-loss path. NEW RISK CLASS: first internal-storage-controller touch on a daily driver — needs Sol cross-review + explicit maintainer approval. Preflight: evidence/2026-07-25-t6040-nvme-probe-preflight.md
author: claude
